heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Can the app work in my city?
items.answer: Yes. We configure maps, fares and payment options for your market.

items.question: Do you build the driver app too?
items.answer: Yes. Passenger app, driver app and admin panel are delivered together.

items.question: Can you add features like ride sharing?
items.answer: Yes. Additional ride types can be added.

items.question: How long does taxi app development take?
items.answer: A launch-ready first version takes 8 to 12 weeks, while a full platform with customer, provider and admin apps takes 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
